Frequently Asked Questions

How was this analysis performed?

Using CORTEX AST Scanner, a Python-based tool that parses C# code using tree-sitter to extract method signatures, class definitions, and architectural patterns without executing the code.

Why can't AST scanning validate compliance?

AST scanning extracts structure (method signatures, parameters) but not implementation logic. We can see that IRSMaxForHSACarryover parameter exists, but not whether it's actually enforced in the method body.

What are the 9 P0 compliance gaps?

Critical regulatory violations: FSA $3,200 annual limit (P0-001), HSA $4,150/$8,300 limit (P0-002), FSA $640 carryover (P0-003), Dependent Care FSA zero carryover (P0-004), plus 5 HIPAA/PCI-DSS gaps.

What is V2 batch processing?

Performance optimization that processes 1,000 accounts per batch with 10 concurrent operations, reducing year-end carryover time from 2-3 hours to 15-20 minutes (85% faster).

How can I access the full analysis?

All markdown documents are stored in C:\PROJECTS\CORTEX\cortex-brain\admin\RA-Domain\documents\. This site is hosted on OneDrive for easy sharing with stakeholders.

What's next after this analysis?

Complete Batches 4-20 (17.6 hours remaining), validate P0 issues via source code review, execute 40+ regulatory test scenarios, generate P0-P3 code quality report.
